tagline: Community bank providing personalized financial services and lending solutions to Texas communities.
hero_kpi_rationale: The Net Interest Margin (FTE) is the primary profitability driver for SBSI, reflecting operational efficiency in interest rate management and balance sheet optimization. The improvement to 2.93% in 2025 demonstrates effective funding cost control despite a volatile rate environment.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin (FTE)
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income earned and borrowing costs, expressed as a percentage of earning assets, measured on a tax-equivalent basis (FTE).
kpis.description: The net interest margin (FTE) increased to 2.93% in 2025 from 2.88% in 2024, supported by lower funding costs and an adjusted asset mix.
kpis.signal: Net interest margin expansion despite a declining rate environment.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the difference between interest received and interest paid.
kpis.description: Net interest income reached $221.1 million in 2025, an increase of $5.0 million compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: Moderate growth in net interest income in 2025.

kpis.name: Total Interest Expense
kpis.explanation: Total amount paid on interest-bearing debt.
kpis.description: Interest expenses decreased by $16.2 million in 2025, driven by lower average rates paid.

kpis.name: Total Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from interest-earning assets such as loans and securities.
kpis.description: Interest income declined by $11.3 million in 2025, due to lower asset yields.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in interest income despite improved margin.

kpis.name: Investment Securities Portfolio
kpis.explanation: Total value of securities held, including municipal and corporate bonds.
kpis.description: The combined portfolio of securities, MBS, FHLB, and other investments decreased to $2.73 billion in 2025 from $2.86 billion in 2024.

kpis.name: Net Unrealized Loss on AFS Portfolio
kpis.explanation: Net unrealized loss on available-for-sale (AFS) securities.
kpis.description: The AFS portfolio reported a net unrealized loss of $767,000 as of December 31, 2025, consisting of $17.9 million in unrealized losses and $17.1 million in unrealized gains.
kpis.signal: Contained unrealized loss in the AFS portfolio.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income sourced from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.069 Bn in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.description: Diluted EPS sourced from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Diluted EPS of $2.29 in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Asset quality and credit loss provisions are managed through a continuous monitoring process, although credit risks persist in an uncertain economic environment.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate volatility represents a significant risk to the bank, despite NIM improvement in 2025. The investment portfolio (notably MBS) is exposed to interest rate fluctuations.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The bank has diversified funding sources (deposits, FHLB, FRDW, repo markets) and an estimated additional funding capacity of $2.45 billion from FHLB.

risks.title: Competition Risk
risks.score_rationale: The community bank operates in a competitive environment against large national banks and other financial institutions in Texas.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: SBSI is subject to strict regulations as a bank holding company of a state-chartered bank. Capital and liquidity requirements evolve regularly.

risks.title: Operational Risk
risks.score_rationale: Like any banking institution, SBSI is exposed to operational risks related to fraud, processing errors, and system failures.

ai_positioning.summary: The company has not mentioned significant AI initiatives or use cases in the provided excerpts.
